title: sterculia cordata var. montana
intro: Sterculia cordata var. montana, commonly known as the Mountain Cotton Tree, is a plant species in the family Malvaceae. It is a medium-sized evergreen tree that is native to the tropical regions of Asia. The Mountain Cotton Tree has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
